sources.snippet: Fara1.5-27B is a 27B-parameter multimodal decoder-only language model fine-tuned from the Qwen 3.5 27B base. It accepts the user's textual goal, current browser screenshot (s), and a textual history of prior thoughts and actions, and emits a chain-of-thought block followed by a structured tool-call block.

sources.snippet: Fara1.5 is a family of native Computer Use Agents (CUAs) at three scales — Fara1.5-4B, Fara1.5-9B, and Fara1.5-27B — built on Qwen3.5 and trained with supervised finetuning on data from FaraGen1.5, our scalable data pipeline of environments, solvers, and verifiers. sources.title: Fara1.5 27B — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Fara1.5-27B is a 27-billion parameter computer use agent model built on Qwen3.5 and trained for browser-based task completion. It achieves 72.3% on Online-Mind2Web benchmark, outperforming larger proprietary systems. The model operates via an observe-think-act loop and is available as open-weight under MIT license.
